# Cross-task summary

1. **R1↔R6:** competitor support for several alternatives does not establish an optimal count; three remains a product constraint. [Choice research](https://scheibehenne.de/ScheibehenneGreifenederTodd2010.pdf)
2. **R2↔R5:** installation registries test market plausibility, while household-specific prediction requires paired inputs and valid labels. [LBNL schema](https://eta-publications.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/2026-08/lbnl_publicdatafile_userguide_8.07.26.pdf)
3. **R3↔R4:** heat-pump model numerals and catalogue steps are not standardized design-condition output. [Aira ratings](https://www.airahome.com/de-de/waermepumpen/ausseneinheiten)
4. **R4↔R6:** declining €/kWh with larger batteries does not establish that extra capacity benefits this household. [Consumer guidance](https://www.verbraucherzentrale.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/lohnen-sich-batteriespeicher-fuer-photovoltaikanlagen-24589)
5. **R5↔R6:** a more persuasive explanation can increase acceptance without improving correctness; traceability matters more than fluency. [CHI evidence](https://aiweb.cs.washington.edu/ai/pubs/bansal-chi21.pdf)
6. **Finding 1:** implement a feasible candidate-bundle pipeline around simple models; test monotonicity after selection and catalogue mapping. [Model constraints](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/ensemble.html)
7. **Finding 2:** prioritize MaStR size distributions plus WPuQ profiles, preserving licensing and electrical/thermal distinctions. [MaStR](https://zenodo.org/records/14843222), [WPuQ](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-022-01156-1)
8. **Finding 3:** expose the next battery size’s additional cost and simulated benefit, separately from backup value. [Comparison precedent](https://getpylon.com/battery-design/)
9. **Finding 4:** validate exact battery/inverter/count/firmware combinations; nominal family capacity is insufficient. [BYD matrix](https://site.bydbatterybox.com/downloads)
10. **Finding 5:** version subsidy calculations now: KfW changed conditions on 21 July 2026, including the first-dwelling cost cap and bonuses. [Official changes](https://www.kfw.de/inlandsfoerderung/Bundesf%C3%B6rderung-f%C3%BCr-effiziente-Geb%C3%A4ude/Anpassungen-2026/)
